spec_match.rationale: Exercises side against the layout rules it interacts with — startOffset, text-anchor, closed vs open paths, and the out-of-range hiding rule — which is exactly how the spec defines right (reverse the path, then apply the normal rules).

interactive.rationale: Path selector, side switch, startOffset slider and text-anchor select all drive the live SVG; path length, text advance and first/last glyph positions are measured back every change.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises the inspection bench including the open-path edge case; the page delivers it with a marked path start point.

edge_cases.rationale: Open-path reversal, offset-past-the-end hiding, anchor interplay, and the unsupported tier are all present and measured; the red start dot makes the direction reversal legible.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, the side section and the text-on-a-path layout rules are linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's open-path-right-reverses-direction assertion encodes this page's edge case; a runner bug (missing outer catch) was found by executing the suite in the browser and fixed before ship.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: autorun set arc + side=right + 20% offset; measurements were real (path 421px, advance 241px, first glyph 93,135), the DOM-vs-rendering divergence was reported honestly, console clean, mobile overflow-free. The reversal itself cannot run on 141; startOffset/anchor/hiding behaviours were genuinely exercised.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe, the attribute-inert fallback branch, and every measured render with path/side/offset/anchor context.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the dashed guide path uses --text-muted on ivory (decorative), text and controls hit AA, controls grid stays 44px.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects/slider/checkbox with visible focus, role=img SVG with title describing the marked start point, aria-live measured readback.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3: zero horizontal overflow, controls stack via auto-fit grid, no console errors.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo control panel sliders without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit minmax grids for control panels so they reflow instead of overflowing (css-layout).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The controls grid is repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px,1fr)); verified zero overflow at 360px emulation.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Every control needs a visible label and the demo's visual outcome needs a text equivalent.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All four controls are labelled with live value text; the measurement table and aria-live readback mirror the rendered outcome.

openQuestions.title: Verify the reversed startOffset origin on a supporting engine
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 156 or Firefox, set the arc, side=right, offset 20%: the note claims text sets off from the far end and offset measures from there. Confirm with the measured first-glyph position (x should sit near the right end) and cite the measured pair on the page.

openQuestions.title: RTL text on a reversed path
openQuestions.detail: The layout rules note negative advances for RTL horizontal text. A follow-up angle could lay Arabic or Hebrew text on the same paths and observe how side=right composes with direction — none of the current concepts cover writing direction.

summary: Inspection bench wiring side to the layout rules it modifies: three paths, live side/startOffset/text-anchor controls, real measurements (path length, advance, first/last glyph), the marked start point, and the out-of-range hiding rule. Chromium 141 evidence is honest about the inert attribute while genuinely exercising every other rule.
